statement: Evaluation logic in scripts/replay_package.py must apply configurable minimum threshold rules.
acceptance_criteria: Entities strictly below the minimum threshold are rejected with an ELIGIBILITY_FAILED error.
Entities meeting or exceeding the threshold receive appropriate rule application.
Computed deductions must not result in negative final totals.

statement: Rule application must respect temporal expiration timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: Expired rules are rejected with RULE_EXPIRED.
